actual: After PR #2412 merged, the approved F2 design requires advisory_real_dev_onboarding.py to expose observe-source, plan-capacity, build-phase1e-inputs and compile-phase1e with explicit env-file/artifact-root and no target-db selector. Current main exposes only commands through run-historical. The compatibility Phase1E CLI still exposes --target-db and cannot serve as the O4 authority. This blocks real DEV O3/O4/G5 execution; manual JSON or direct internal-service invocation would violate the no-simplification and no-silent-semantic-drift contract. Fix must wire the complete O4 command chain into the authoritative CLI, preserve explicit DEV-only identity, exact artifact refs/readback, existing compatibility behavior where approved, and add direct CLI contract tests mapped to F-906..F-916.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
